issues.issue: Performance advice ('Run the expensive stages on the side that is big/expensive — usually remotely') is editorial material not present in the source. The source describes the mechanism of quoted vs unquoted ssh pipes but does not advise on which to choose.

The specific claim that 'pipelines can terminate early when the downstream command exits (e.g. grep | head stops once head has enough lines)' is material not in the source. The source covers pipeline concurrency but not early-termination behavior or this example.

SIGPIPE is listed in the small common-set summary but is not mentioned in the source. The '~30 signals' count is also not in the source. Minor: 'ssh falls back to prompting for the remote account's password' slightly misrepresents the source, which presents passwords as an alternative option rather than a fallback.
